# BT Banana Wholesale

> BT Banana is a wholesale banana and banana seed (Vazhavithu) supplier based on Malayora Highway in Alakode, Kannur district, Kerala, India, with a second branch in Nellipara. We supply fresh wholesale bananas, raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka) for chips manufacturing, and disease-free banana seeds (planting material) to farmers, traders, chips makers, and retailers across Kannur, Kasaragod, Wayanad, and surrounding Kerala regions.

## Key Facts

- Business name: BT Banana Wholesale
- Physical locations:
  - Main Branch: Malayora Highway, Opp. Rajadhani Hotel, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala 670571
  - Second Branch: Nellipara, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala
- Key contacts / Owners:
  - Thomas M.J (Owner) — Phone: +91 9447483169
  - Albin Augustine (Owner) — Phone: +91 8086648081
- Service area: Kannur district, Kasaragod district, and Wayanad district, Kerala — including Alakode, Nellipara, Kannur town, Thaliparamba, Cherupuzha, Chittarikkal, Vellarikundu, Bheemanady, Parappa, Nileshwaram, Udayagiri, Manakkadavu, Karthikapuram, Kappimala, Ottathai, Arangam, Kalpetta, and Mananthavady.
- Products supplied:
  - Raw Banana for Chips: High-starch raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka / പച്ച ഏത്തക്ക) harvested at 85–90% maturity for chips factories and hot chips stalls.
  - Wholesale Bananas: Nendran banana, Njali Poovan (ഞാലിപ്പൂവൻ), Palayankodan / Mysore Poovan (പാളയംകോടൻ), Robusta (റോബസ്റ്റ), and Poovan.
  - Banana Seeds (Vazhavithu / വാഴവിത്ത്): High-yield, healthy banana suckers and planting material for commercial farming and cultivation.
- Pricing structure: Rates are determined by daily morning market arrivals, bunch grading, and volume. Live quotes are shared transparently via phone and WhatsApp.
- Official website: https://www.btbanana.com
